definition: |daily return| > 50% on Close or Adj Close (consecutive observations). Flagged, NOT removed. category: split_related (jump matches a split ratio within +-5 obs), spans_data_gap (>5 missing trading days before the move), spike_reversal (price returns within 25% of pre-jump level within 5 obs), persistent_move (otherwise; often genuine: bankruptcy, takeover, biotech readout).
